metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows a really easy way to get quick sciatica pain relief in a chair.

This exercise will focus on a deep, pulling motion (called decompression traction) to help open up the lower back and relieve pressure on bulging discs and pinched nerves.

Let us know how it works for you!
